description: Get your chain-abstracted balance (CAB) -- a unified view of your tokens across all EVM chains. Shows total USDC, USDT, WETH, ETH across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, and Tempo.

homeChain.description: Home chain for the vault (default: base). One of: base, ethereum, arbitrum, polygon, bnb, avalanche, tempo

tokens.description: Comma-separated token tickers to check (default: USDC,USDT,WETH,ETH)

name: get_cab_balance
